items.q: Does WOS charge extra fees on top of the program price?
items.a: The price shown for each program is the final price — no hidden fees.

items.q: Do I need to pay in advance?
items.a: It depends on the program. Our team will explain the payment details clearly before confirming your booking.

items.q: Can I cancel or reschedule my booking?
items.a: Contact our team via LINE/WhatsApp to reschedule or cancel, subject to each partner's terms.
Every hospital and clinic must pass a license and standards check before joining our network.

items.q: How do I communicate with the doctor if I don't speak Thai?
items.a: Our team provides interpreters and multilingual support throughout your trip.
